note: Only convars confirmed to exist in CS2 are emitted. A convar that does not exist prints an error to the console at exec time, which turns a config into noise and hides real problems. When in doubt a setting is left out of this list rather than guessed at.

fps_max.reason: Uncapped is right whenever the machine clears the refresh rate comfortably. Capping only helps when the cap is reachable every single frame, which is what keeps frametimes flat.

fps_max_ui.reason: Menus have no reason to render faster than the panel. Costs nothing in game and keeps the card from spinning up in the lobby.

engine_no_focus_sleep.comment: Keep rendering when the window loses focus
engine_no_focus_sleep.reason: Prevents the frame rate collapsing on alt-tab, so returning to the game does not cost a second of stutter.

rate.comment: Maximum bytes per second the client will accept
rate.reason: CS2's default and maximum. The 128000 figure that circulates in old configs is a CS:GO-era number and is a straight downgrade here.

r_player_visibility_mode.comment: Player model contrast against the map
r_player_visibility_mode.reason: Boosts player readability against backgrounds. Purely a legibility setting, no frame cost.

cl_teamid_overhead_always.comment: Always draw teammate markers through walls
cl_teamid_overhead_always.reason: Preference, not performance. Listed so the tool knows the name is real, but never written automatically.
